name: my-agent
description: Universal AI Software Engineering Agent - Cross-platform, IDE-agnostic, polyglot support

scripts.setup: npm run install-all && npm run init-db
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:sdk
scripts.install:backend: cd backend/core && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../api-gateway && npm install
scripts.install:frontend: cd frontend/web && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install
scripts.install:sdk: cd sdk/python-sdk && pip install -e . && cd ../typescript-sdk && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend/core && docker build -t my-agent:core . && cd ../api-gateway && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend/web && npm run build && cd ../desktop && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
